route_policy: dense fixed-pose observations sampled along Habitat navmesh shortest paths between the original main_600 waypoints; original waypoints preserved in order

dense_route_provenance.route_validation: Habitat Pathfinder shortest paths; each generated pose is on the validated polyline and all generated consecutive pairs must pass route validation
dense_route_provenance.orientation_interpolation: quaternion SLERP for in-place yaw transitions; travel headings follow each navmesh path segment; corner turns subdivided to at most 30 degrees
dense_route_provenance.timestamp_policy: capture timestamp = frame_index * simulation_step_s; simulation_step_s remains unchanged
